title: 🔋 Ira swipes every app shut... the battery cost nobody mentions #battery #smartphone
title_alts: 📲 Ira clears her app switcher hourly... what a cold start really costs #battery #android
🪫 Ira wants longer battery life... the swipe habit to drop first #battery #phonetips
description_hook: Closing apps by hand feels like housekeeping for your battery. The phone was already doing it better.

characters.name: Ira
characters.description: late twenties, shoulder-length black hair, grey hooded sweatshirt, small silver nose stud

claims.claim: a chat app needs three seconds to start from cold
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption for a cold app launch, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: swipe it shut twenty times a day
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: the top three apps on the list
claims.basis: refers to reading the first three rows of the phone's own battery screen, not a measured quantity

scenes.narration: Swiping apps closed makes your phone spend more battery, not less.
scenes.caption: एप बंद करने वाली स्वाइप बैटरी बचाने के बजाय ज़्यादा खर्च कराती है
scenes.image_brief: A smartphone lying on a wooden desk, its screen showing the app switcher with four stacked app cards, one card lifted upward by a single fingertip, warm lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: Both Android and iPhone freeze an app the moment you leave it.
scenes.caption: एंड्रॉइड और आईफ़ोन, दोनों एप को बाहर निकलते ही फ़्रीज़ कर देते हैं
scenes.image_brief: The same smartphone flat on the desk, screen showing two app cards sitting still side by side with dimmed edges, soft morning light from a window behind it.

scenes.narration: A frozen app holds memory and burns nothing while it waits.
scenes.caption: फ़्रीज़ एप मेमोरी में पड़ा रहता है, और बिजली कुछ नहीं खाता
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen filled with one paused app card covered in a pale frost pattern, resting on a dark table in cool blue light.

scenes.narration: So here is what that upward swipe actually costs you.
scenes.caption: तो वो ऊपर की स्वाइप असल में कितनी महंगी पड़ती है, यह समझिए
scenes.image_brief: A phone standing upright in a holder against a plain wall, its screen showing an upward arrow drawn across a stack of app cards, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Closing an app throws it out of memory completely.
scenes.caption: एप बंद करने से वो मेमोरी से पूरी तरह बाहर हो जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen where one app card is missing and an empty grey slot remains in the switcher row, low evening light on a dark table.

scenes.narration: Opening it again reloads the code, the data and the network calls. That burns power.
scenes.caption: दोबारा खोलते ही कोड, डेटा और नेटवर्क फिर लोड होते हैं। यही बिजली खाता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk showing an app loading screen with a spinning indicator and a thin progress bar at the bottom, bright overhead kitchen light.

scenes.narration: Say a chat app needs three seconds to start from cold.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए किसी चैट एप को पूरा खुलने में तीन सेकंड लगते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a cafe table showing a chat app opening screen, a small stopwatch beside it reading three seconds, warm afternoon light through a window.

scenes.narration: Swipe it shut twenty times a day and you pay that start twenty times.
scenes.caption: दिन में बीस बार बंद किया, तो यह खर्च बीस बार देना पड़ेगा
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk beside a paper tally sheet marked with twenty pencil strokes and a small battery symbol drawn under them, daylight from the right.

scenes.narration: One exception. An app that heats the phone or freezes should be closed.
scenes.caption: एक अपवाद है। जो एप फ़ोन गरम करे या अटक जाए, उसे बंद करना सही है
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up on a bedsheet with heat shimmer rising from its back and a warning triangle on the screen, dim bedside lamp light.

scenes.narration: That is a repair, not a daily routine.
scenes.caption: यह मरम्मत है, रोज़ की आदत नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a workbench beside a small screwdriver and one printed app card set aside, cool workshop light from above.

scenes.narration: Battery goes to screen brightness, weak signal hunting and heat.
scenes.caption: बैटरी स्क्रीन की चमक, कमज़ोर सिग्नल और गरमी में जाती है
scenes.image_brief: A phone glowing at full brightness on a night table, its light washing the wall behind it, a single weak signal bar at the top of the screen, dark room.

scenes.narration: The app switcher is not a cleaning tool.
scenes.caption: एप स्विचर सफ़ाई का औज़ार नहीं है
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the app switcher, with a small broom and dustpan resting untouched on the desk beside the phone, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Open battery settings and read the top three apps on the list.
scenes.caption: बैटरी सेटिंग खोलिए और सबसे ऊपर के तीन एप पढ़िए
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a battery usage list with the top three app rows highlighted and percentage bars beside them, bright daylight on a plain desk.

title: 🌙 Mehul turned on dark mode everywhere... the screen type that decides #darkmode #battery
title_alts: 💡 Mehul wants dark mode to save power... the panel word to look for #oled #darkmode
🔎 Mehul switched every app to black... the brightness slider he ignored #darkmode #battery
description_hook: Dark mode does save power, but only on one kind of panel. Here is how to tell which one you are holding.

characters.name: Mehul
characters.description: early thirties, short cropped hair, round glasses, plain navy t-shirt

claims.claim: a dark interface turns seventy percent of pixels black
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption for a dark interface, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: panel draw can fall by a third on OLED
claims.basis: illustrative order of magnitude for a mostly black screen on a self-lit panel

claims.claim: half brightness saves more than any theme
claims.basis: illustrative comparison of backlight power against interface colour

scenes.narration: Dark mode saves battery on some screens and not others.
scenes.caption: डार्क मोड कुछ स्क्रीन पर बैटरी बचाता है, बाक़ी पर नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a dark interface and an identical phone in a light interface lying side by side on a black table, both showing the same plain menu, dim room light.

scenes.narration: Phone panels come in two kinds, OLED and LCD.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन की स्क्रीन दो तरह की होती है, ओलेड और एलसीडी
scenes.image_brief: Two bare phone panels lying apart on a grey surface, each with a small paper label card beside it reading OLED and LCD, even soft light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know which one you own.
scenes.caption: अंत तक पता चल जाएगा कि आपके पास कौन सी स्क्रीन है
scenes.image_brief: A phone box open on a table with its specification sheet unfolded beside it and the display line visible, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: An OLED lights every pixel on its own, with no shared lamp.
scenes.caption: ओलेड में हर पिक्सल खुद जलता है, कोई साझा लैंप नहीं होता
scenes.image_brief: A magnified grid of tiny coloured squares on an OLED panel, each square glowing separately with pure black gaps between them, dark surroundings.

scenes.narration: A black OLED pixel switches off and draws nothing. An LCD keeps its backlight burning.
scenes.caption: काला ओलेड पिक्सल बंद रहता है। एलसीडी की बैकलाइट जलती रहती है
scenes.image_brief: An opened LCD panel on a workbench with one long white backlight strip glowing behind a grid of pixels, dim room.

scenes.narration: Say a dark interface turns seventy percent of pixels black.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए डार्क डिज़ाइन सत्तर फ़ीसद पिक्सल काले कर देता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen that is mostly black with a few white text lines near the top, resting on a dark cloth with no other light in the room.

scenes.narration: Panel draw can fall by a third on OLED and stays flat on LCD.
scenes.caption: ओलेड पर स्क्रीन की खपत करीब तिहाई गिरती है, एलसीडी पर वैसी ही
scenes.image_brief: Two identical battery meters drawn side by side on a whiteboard, one arrow dropping a third lower than the other, flat office light.

scenes.narration: One catch. Dark grey still lights pixels, so pure black matters.
scenes.caption: एक पेच है। गहरा स्लेटी फिर भी जलता है, पूरा काला ही काम करता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen half filled with faintly glowing dark grey panels and half with a patch of pure black, dark room.

scenes.narration: Brightness beats colour anyway. Half brightness saves more than any theme.
scenes.caption: चमक का असर ज़्यादा है। आधी चमक किसी भी थीम से बेहतर बचाती है
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a bedside table with an on screen brightness slider dragged to the halfway point, low evening light.

scenes.narration: So dark mode is a display trick, not a battery setting.
scenes.caption: तो डार्क मोड स्क्रीन की बात है, बैटरी की सेटिंग नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A single phone panel lying alone on a plain table with a small label card beside it reading OLED, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Your panel decides the saving. The app cannot.
scenes.caption: बचत आपकी स्क्रीन तय करती है। एप नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a dark interface with one settings toggle switched on, resting on a card that shows the panel type printed in plain text, even light.

scenes.narration: Search your phone model's display spec for the word OLED.
scenes.caption: अपने फ़ोन मॉडल की डिस्प्ले जानकारी में ओलेड शब्द ढूंढिए
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a phone specification page with the display row highlighted, bright daytime light through a window.

title: 🫣 Pallavi trusted incognito mode... the one watcher it never hides #incognito #privacy
title_alts: 🔍 Pallavi opens a private tab at work... who still sees the address #incognito #browser
🧾 Pallavi wants private browsing to hide her... the log left behind #privacy #incognito
description_hook: Private browsing clears one list on one device. Everything between your device and the site keeps its own copy.

characters.name: Pallavi
characters.description: early twenties, long braided hair, olive green kurta, thin wire bracelet

claims.claim: open ten private tabs on a shared hostel network
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: the router still records ten requests
claims.basis: follows directly from the ten tabs already stated in the example

scenes.narration: Incognito mode hides your browsing from your family, not your provider.
scenes.caption: इनकॉग्निटो मोड ब्राउज़िंग घरवालों से छिपाता है, इंटरनेट कंपनी से नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a kitchen table showing a browser window in private mode with a dark address bar, a quiet household room behind it, warm ceiling light.

scenes.narration: It was built to solve one problem, the local history list.
scenes.caption: यह एक ही समस्या के लिए बना था, लोकल हिस्ट्री की लिस्ट
scenes.image_brief: A browser history page on a laptop screen, the list empty except for a single heading, soft daylight through a window.

scenes.narration: Your device forgets. The network still remembers.
scenes.caption: आपका डिवाइस भूल जाता है। नेटवर्क अब भी याद रखता है
scenes.image_brief: A closed laptop on a desk beside a router with blinking lights and a narrow paper log curling out onto the desk, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Here is exactly who can still see the pages you open.
scenes.caption: अब समझिए कि आपके खोले पेज कौन कौन देख सकता है
scenes.image_brief: A desk with a laptop in private browsing and a simple hand drawn diagram on the wall behind it showing a home router and a distant server building, even light.

scenes.narration: Every page you open begins with a lookup of the site name.
scenes.caption: हर पेज खुलने से पहले साइट के नाम की खोज होती है
scenes.image_brief: A browser address bar on a laptop screen with a site name typed in, and an arrow drawn from the bar to a small server cabinet beside the desk, cool light.

scenes.narration: That lookup travels to a resolver, and your provider can log it.
scenes.caption: यह खोज एक रिज़ॉल्वर तक जाती है, जिसे कंपनी दर्ज कर सकती है
scenes.image_brief: A network cabinet in a corridor with one labelled resolver box and a long printed list of site names hanging beside it, harsh ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Open ten private tabs on a shared hostel network.
scenes.caption: किसी हॉस्टल के साझा नेटवर्क पर दस प्राइवेट टैब खोलिए
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a hostel bunk bed showing ten stacked private browser tabs, backpacks and a shared study table around it, low lamp light.

scenes.narration: The router still records ten requests, all tied to your device address.
scenes.caption: राउटर दस रिक्वेस्ट दर्ज करता है, सब आपके डिवाइस पते से जुड़ी
scenes.image_brief: A router on a shelf with a paper log beside it listing ten identical request lines under one device address, dim corridor light.

scenes.narration: One thing it does fix. A borrowed laptop keeps no trace afterwards.
scenes.caption: एक बात यह सुधारता है। मांगे हुए लैपटॉप पर कोई निशान नहीं बचता
scenes.image_brief: A borrowed laptop on a library table with an empty browser history page open, an otherwise clean desk, bright overhead light.

scenes.narration: Downloaded files and finished logins still stay behind on the machine.
scenes.caption: डाउनलोड फ़ाइलें और पूरे हुए लॉगिन मशीन पर रह जाते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A downloads folder open on a laptop screen showing two saved files, with a signed in account page visible behind it, daylight from the side.

scenes.narration: So private browsing is privacy from the people beside you.
scenes.caption: तो प्राइवेट ब्राउज़िंग सिर्फ़ पास बैठे लोगों से पर्दा है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a living room table with a private browsing window open and an empty sofa beside it, soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: It is a clean slate, not a cloak.
scenes.caption: यह साफ़ स्लेट है, कोई नकाब नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A wiped writing slate lying on a wooden desk beside a folded dark cloth that has been set aside, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Pick one site you thought incognito hid. Check its login history.
scenes.caption: एक साइट चुनिए जिसे इनकॉग्निटो ने छिपाया समझा था। उसकी लॉगिन हिस्ट्री देखिए
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a website account security page with a login history list of dates and devices, bright daylight.

title: 📷 Ojas paid for more megapixels... the number that actually matters #megapixels #phonecamera
title_alts: 🌃 Ojas shoots indoors on a big megapixel phone... why the noise stays #megapixels #lowlight
🔬 Ojas compares two phone cameras... the sensor size spec to check #camera #megapixels
description_hook: The megapixel number counts dots, not light. Two quieter specs decide whether your indoor photos look clean.

characters.name: Ojas
characters.description: mid thirties, close cropped beard, denim jacket, camera strap worn across the chest

claims.claim: a forty eight megapixel phone usually hands you a twelve megapixel photo
claims.basis: typical four to one pixel binning on high count phone sensors, described as the usual case

claims.claim: four tiny pixels are merged into one bigger bucket
claims.basis: follows arithmetically from the forty eight to twelve megapixel figures already stated

scenes.narration: More megapixels will not rescue a photo shot in poor light.
scenes.caption: कम रोशनी में खींची तस्वीर को ज़्यादा मेगापिक्सल नहीं बचाते
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a dim living room table showing a grainy dark photo of a sofa on its screen, one small lamp lit across the room.

scenes.narration: The megapixel number counts dots on the sensor and nothing else.
scenes.caption: मेगापिक्सल सिर्फ़ सेंसर के बिंदु गिनता है, इससे ज़्यादा कुछ नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A phone camera specification card standing on a desk with a large megapixel number printed across it, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Two other numbers matter more, and both are easy to find.
scenes.caption: दो और आंकड़े ज़्यादा मायने रखते हैं, और दोनों आसानी से मिलते हैं
scenes.image_brief: Two small printed cards lying on a table beside a phone, one reading sensor size and one reading lens opening, even light.

scenes.narration: Picture each pixel as a tiny bucket left out to collect light.
scenes.caption: हर पिक्सल को रोशनी जमा करने वाली छोटी बाल्टी समझिए
scenes.image_brief: A row of small metal buckets on a windowsill catching sunlight, each half filled with water, bright midday light.

scenes.narration: Cram more buckets onto the same sensor and every bucket shrinks. Small buckets mean noise.
scenes.caption: एक ही सेंसर पर ज़्यादा बाल्टियां, तो हर बाल्टी छोटी। छोटी का मतलब शोर
scenes.image_brief: The same windowsill crowded with many tiny buckets pressed together, each holding only a few drops, bright light.

scenes.narration: A forty eight megapixel phone usually hands you a twelve megapixel photo.
scenes.caption: अड़तालीस मेगापिक्सल वाला फ़ोन आमतौर पर बारह मेगापिक्सल तस्वीर देता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone gallery screen showing one photo with its details panel open, listing a twelve megapixel image size, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Four tiny pixels are merged into one bigger bucket. Cleaner, not sharper.
scenes.caption: चार छोटे पिक्सल मिलकर एक बड़ी बाल्टी बनते हैं। साफ़, ज़्यादा शार्प नहीं
scenes.image_brief: Four tiny buckets on a table being poured into one larger bucket, the water catching the light, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: In bright daylight those extra pixels genuinely help you crop in tighter.
scenes.caption: तेज़ धूप में वो अतिरिक्त पिक्सल क्रॉप करने में सच में काम आते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A bright outdoor photo on a phone screen with a crop frame drawn tightly around a distant signboard, strong sunlight falling on the phone.

scenes.narration: Indoors after sunset they mostly help the advertising.
scenes.caption: सूरज ढलने के बाद घर के अंदर वो सिर्फ़ विज्ञापन के काम आते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped on a shelf in a dim room beside a glossy advertising card printed with a huge megapixel number, weak indoor light.

scenes.narration: Sensor size and lens opening beat the headline number every time.
scenes.caption: सेंसर का आकार और लेंस का खुलना हर बार बड़े आंकड़े को हरा देते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A large camera sensor and a wide lens element resting side by side on a dark cloth over a small printed spec sheet, soft light.

scenes.narration: Open your darkest photo and zoom right into the shadows.
scenes.caption: अपनी सबसे अंधेरी तस्वीर खोलिए और परछाइयों में ज़ूम कीजिए
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a dark table showing a night photo zoomed into its shadow area with grainy patches visible, low room light.

title: 🐢 Saloni added more RAM... the slow part she never checked first #ram #ssd
title_alts: 💾 Saloni wants a faster old laptop... the disk number to watch first #ssd #ram
📊 Saloni's laptop crawls at startup... the upgrade that fixes nothing #laptop #ram
description_hook: More memory is the upgrade everyone reaches for first. The part that actually stalls is usually the drive.

characters.name: Saloni
characters.description: forties, hair tied in a low bun, maroon cardigan, reading glasses on a cord

claims.claim: a spinning hard drive answers a request in about ten milliseconds
claims.basis: round illustrative figure for mechanical seek and rotation time

claims.claim: an SSD answers in well under one
claims.basis: round illustrative comparison against the ten millisecond figure just stated

claims.claim: a hundred times the wait
claims.basis: ratio of the two illustrative response times already stated in the narration

claims.claim: pinned at a hundred percent while memory use hovers near half
claims.basis: round illustrative monitor readings, stated as an example

claims.claim: twenty browser tabs beside a video editor
claims.basis: round illustrative workload, stated as such in the narration

scenes.narration: Adding RAM rarely fixes a slow old laptop.
scenes.caption: पुराने धीमे लैपटॉप में रैम बढ़ाने से कम ही फ़र्क़ पड़ता है
scenes.image_brief: An open laptop on a desk with two memory sticks lying beside it still in their packaging, dust on the keyboard, cool morning light.

scenes.narration: Slowness has three suspects, the drive, the memory and the processor.
scenes.caption: धीमेपन के तीन मुलज़िम हैं, ड्राइव, मेमोरी और प्रोसेसर
scenes.image_brief: Three labelled parts laid out in a row on a workbench, a hard drive, a memory stick and a processor chip, even overhead light.

scenes.narration: Only one of them stalls for whole seconds at a time.
scenes.caption: इनमें सिर्फ़ एक पूरे पूरे सेकंड तक अटकाता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen frozen mid load with a waiting cursor, and a stopwatch on the desk beside it reading several seconds, dim light.

scenes.narration: Which of the three is it? One window tells you.
scenes.caption: तीनों में कौन? एक विंडो बता देती है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a resource monitor window with four columns of live figures, bright desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: A spinning hard drive answers a request in about ten milliseconds.
scenes.caption: घूमने वाली हार्ड ड्राइव करीब दस मिलीसेकंड में जवाब देती है
scenes.image_brief: An opened mechanical hard drive on a bench with its platter and arm visible and a small dial gauge beside it, harsh work light.

scenes.narration: An SSD answers in well under one. Same request, a hundred times the wait.
scenes.caption: एसएसडी एक से भी कम में। वही काम, सौ गुना इंतज़ार
scenes.image_brief: A small solid state drive board lying flat on a bench beside the larger mechanical drive, a stopwatch between them, cool white light.

scenes.narration: Boot a laptop with a spinning drive and watch the disk figure.
scenes.caption: घूमने वाली ड्राइव वाला लैपटॉप चालू कीजिए और डिस्क का आंकड़ा देखिए
scenes.image_brief: A laptop starting up on a kitchen table showing a loading logo, with a resource monitor window open on a second screen behind it, morning light.

scenes.narration: It sits pinned at a hundred percent while memory use hovers near half.
scenes.caption: वो सौ फ़ीसद पर अटका रहता है, जबकि मेमोरी आधी के आसपास रहती है
scenes.image_brief: A resource monitor window on a laptop screen with the disk row reading one hundred percent and the memory row near half, the disk row highlighted, indoor light.

scenes.narration: RAM does matter once you actually run out of it.

scenes.narration: Twenty browser tabs beside a video editor will genuinely need more.

scenes.narration: So watch which number pins itself to a hundred percent. That is the part to replace.

title: 🤨 Chirag pays for a hundred megabits... why downloads never match it #internetspeed #mbps
title_alts: 📉 Chirag's download crawls on a fast plan... the divide by eight rule #mbps #internetspeed
🧮 Chirag reads megabits as megabytes... the number your plan means #mbps #broadband
description_hook: Your plan is measured in bits and your files in bytes. One division turns the advertised figure into the speed you actually see.

characters.name: Chirag
characters.description: thirties, thick black hair combed back, striped shirt, wristwatch with a worn leather strap

claims.claim: a hundred megabit plan never gives a hundred megabytes
claims.basis: follows from the eight bits per byte conversion stated in the narration

claims.claim: eight bits make one byte
claims.basis: fixed definition of a byte, unchanging

claims.claim: a hundred megabits per second becomes twelve and a half megabytes
claims.basis: one hundred divided by eight, arithmetic from the figures already stated

claims.claim: a two gigabyte film holds about sixteen thousand megabits of data
claims.basis: two thousand megabytes multiplied by eight, arithmetic from the figures already stated

claims.claim: that download needs about one hundred sixty seconds
claims.basis: sixteen thousand megabits divided by a hundred megabits per second

scenes.narration: A hundred megabit plan never gives a hundred megabytes.
scenes.caption: सौ मेगाबिट का प्लान कभी सौ मेगाबाइट नहीं देता
scenes.image_brief: An internet plan leaflet on a table printed with a large hundred megabit figure, and a laptop behind it showing a download running at a much smaller speed, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Internet plans are sold in bits. Files on your disk are measured in bytes.
scenes.caption: इंटरनेट प्लान बिट में बिकते हैं। डिस्क की फ़ाइलें बाइट में नापी जाती हैं
scenes.image_brief: Two labelled jars on a shelf, one holding eight small beads and marked bits, the other marked bytes and holding a single large bead, even light.

scenes.narration: Eight bits make one byte, and that eight explains everything.
scenes.caption: आठ बिट से एक बाइट बनता है, और यही आठ सब समझा देता है
scenes.image_brief: Eight small beads lined up on a table beside one larger bead, with a paper label reading one byte under the large bead, soft light.

scenes.narration: Why the gap? One division gives you the real number.
scenes.caption: फ़र्क़ क्यों? एक भाग असली आंकड़ा दे देता है
scenes.image_brief: A notepad on a desk with a large division sign and a question mark drawn on it, a router sitting beside the pad, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Take the advertised megabits per second and divide them by eight.
scenes.caption: बताए गए मेगाबिट प्रति सेकंड को आठ से भाग दीजिए
scenes.image_brief: A calculator on a desk showing a hundred divided by eight, resting on the internet plan leaflet, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: A hundred megabits per second becomes twelve and a half megabytes.
scenes.caption: सौ मेगाबिट प्रति सेकंड साढ़े बारह मेगाबाइट बन जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A whiteboard with twelve and a half megabytes per second written large and the hundred megabit figure crossed out above it, office light.

scenes.narration: A two gigabyte film holds about sixteen thousand megabits of data.
scenes.caption: दो गीगाबाइट की फ़िल्म में करीब सोलह हज़ार मेगाबिट डेटा होता है
scenes.image_brief: A film file icon on a laptop screen labelled two gigabytes with its size details panel open beside it, evening room light.

scenes.narration: At twelve and a half megabytes a second, that download needs about one hundred sixty seconds.
scenes.caption: साढ़े बारह मेगाबाइट प्रति सेकंड पर उसे करीब एक सौ साठ सेकंड लगेंगे
scenes.image_brief: A download progress bar part way across a laptop screen, with a kitchen timer beside the laptop set to one hundred sixty seconds, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Overhead takes a slice too. Expect slightly less than the maths promises.
scenes.caption: कुछ हिस्सा ओवरहेड लेता है। हिसाब से थोड़ा कम ही मिलेगा
scenes.image_brief: A wide pipe on a workbench with a narrow sleeve fitted inside it, water passing through the reduced opening slowly, cool light.

scenes.narration: Your Wi-Fi, the server and your own disk can each cap it lower.
scenes.caption: आपका वाई-फ़ाई, सर्वर और आपकी डिस्क, हर एक रफ़्तार घटा सकता है
scenes.image_brief: A router, a distant server rack and a laptop drive arranged in a row across a desk, each with a small narrow gate standing in front of it, even light.

scenes.narration: So nobody is lying in the advertisement. They are counting bits.
scenes.caption: तो विज्ञापन झूठ नहीं बोल रहा। वो बिट गिन रहा है
scenes.image_brief: An internet plan leaflet on a table with the word megabit circled in pen, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: Divide by eight and the disappointment disappears.
scenes.caption: आठ से भाग दीजिए और निराशा ख़त्म हो जाएगी
scenes.image_brief: A calculator resting on the plan leaflet showing the result twelve point five, with a tick drawn beside it on the paper, soft light.

scenes.narration: Run a speed test now and divide the result by eight.
scenes.caption: स्पीड टेस्ट चलाइए और नतीजे को आठ से भाग दीजिए
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk showing a finished speed test result, with a calculator beside it displaying the divided figure, bright daylight.
